overview_description.description: Built is the leading AI-native platform for real estate and construction finance. We help lenders, developers, and contractors save time and money by replacing spreadsheets, email, and manual work with a single system for draws, inspections, and payments. With Built, capital moves faster, data stays clean, and risk stays in check. More than 625 banks, private credit lenders, owners, and general contractors rely on Built to manage over $350 billion in real estate and construction activity annually. Learn more at www.getbuilt.com.

about_short_description.short_description: Built is the leading AI-native platform for real estate and construction finance.

product.name: Built Platform
product.description: A cloud-based construction lending software platform that centralizes construction loan administration, draw management, accounts payable, lien waiver management, compliance tracking, and payments.

product.name: Construction Accounts Payable Automation
product.description: Software tools to automate the collection, approval, coding, and payment of construction-related invoices, including progress billing and compliance verification.

product.name: Lien Waiver Management
product.description: A digital system to create, send, collect, and track lien waivers electronically, ensuring legal compliance and facilitating payment processes.

product.name: Construction Loan Management
product.description: A platform for financial institutions to manage construction loan administration, monitoring, and reporting with real-time data and risk mitigation tools.

product.name: Integration Services
product.description: Integration capabilities that connect Built’s platform with accounting, project management, and payment systems to synchronize data and reduce manual entry.

product.name: Draw Agent
product.description: AI-powered tool in Built Technologies' platform that automates review and approval of residential construction draw requests.
